newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican soldier dies in clash with armed group.
newsitem.headline: Mexican soldier dies in clash with armed group.

text.p: A Mexican soldier died on Tuesday in a clash between the military and a group of unidentified civilians in the southwestern state of Guerrero, the military said.
The incident took place near the small community of "El Quemado," when the armed group attacked a military patrol, the military said in a statement.

"Part of a permanent reconnaissance mission against narco-traffickers was attacked with firearms by a group of about 25 armed men," the statement said. "The result was the death of infantryman Abad Noyola Calderon, who belonged to the 49th Infantry Battalion."
Residents in El Qemado told Reuters the military was involved in an intensive helicopter search for the armed civilians involved in the attack.
